what.en: A building collapse is when part or all of a building falls down. Strong shaking, weak materials, or old damage can cause it.
what.fil: Ang pagguho ng gusali ay kapag bumagsak ang bahagi o buong gusali. Maaari itong dulot ng malakas na pagyanig, mahinang materyales, o lumang sira.

signs.en: Big cracks in walls or floors, tilting walls or posts, and bits of cement falling off. After an earthquake, damaged buildings can fall during aftershocks.
signs.fil: Malalaking bitak sa pader o sahig, tumatagilid na pader o poste, at nalalaglag na piraso ng semento. Pagkatapos ng lindol, maaaring bumagsak ang sirang gusali kapag may aftershock.

before.en: Help your family look for cracks at home, and tell an adult if you find any. Know the exits of your home and classroom.
before.fil: Tulungan ang pamilya na maghanap ng bitak sa bahay, at sabihan ang nakatatanda kapag may nakita ka. Alamin ang mga labasan ng bahay at silid-aralan.

during.en: Stay away from damaged buildings, and tell an adult right away! If you are inside when shaking starts, Duck, Cover, and Hold.
during.fil: Lumayo sa sirang gusali, at sabihan agad ang nakatatanda! Kung nasa loob ka kapag nagsimula ang pagyanig, Duck, Cover, and Hold.

after.en: Never go back into a damaged building until engineers say it's safe. Stay away from broken walls and fallen wires, and watch for aftershocks.
after.fil: Huwag bumalik sa sirang gusali hangga't hindi sinasabi ng mga engineer na ligtas na. Lumayo sa gumuhong pader at nahulog na kable, at mag-ingat sa aftershock.

signoff.en: Remember: see a crack, step back, and tell an adult!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: may bitak? Lumayo, at sabihan ang nakatatanda!
